panels.rationale: Real clinical photograph of the axilla of a patient with a drug-induced eruption (article title: acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis induced by ceftriaxone), which is indexed in this library under morbilliform_drug_eruption. The panel shows confluent erythematous lesions with superimposed pustules in the flexural (axillary) skin, matching the caption "Pustular erythematous lesions of the armpits" and the in-text description of a widespread drug rash involving the armpits. Because the morphology is pustular rather than a classic maculopapular exanthem, typicality is judged atypical and confidence is moderate; pustules and flexural distribution are not in the provided vocabulary and are recorded as proposed findings. No ethnicity, age, or laterality data were stated in the caption or in-text.
